name: approve_purchase_request
title: Approve purchase request
description: Approve or reject a purchase request that waits for the signed-in user. Only the named approver can do this, never the person who raised it.

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

policy.on_lost_write_reply: never resent blindly: look the document up (by its key or by what changed) and return it
policy.on_busy_before_write: ok=false with next_step; nothing was saved, so the same call is safe to repeat

release_notes.1.1: 3 Nov 2026 (Lecture 4 production-grade pass): a lost pr_approve reply is read back: the decision is reported, not a misleading 'not pending' error on the retry.
